title: Verify branch protection gates on a normal PR
scope: Add a documentation-only smoke-test artifact and use the PR to verify branch protection, required checks, CCA, and MergeGate behavior.
non_goals: Do not change Shiki runtime policy.
Do not change GitHub workflow behavior.
Do not merge unless required checks prove the gate behavior.
acceptance_checks: Validate Shiki mirror passes on PR #6.
CCA verdict produces a machine-readable verdict on PR #6.
MergeGate policy check consumes the CCA verdict and passes only when CCA is complete.
Branch protection blocks merge until required checks are green.
